work_unit: Prevent and diagnose restricted-runtime OpenAI OCR failures

execution.reason: The preflight, safe logging, local launcher, and tests share one provider contract; parallel writers would increase integration risk.

behavior.startup: The supported local launcher sends one bounded document-free request before starting the API. It fails fast if the key, configured OCR model, quota, or outbound provider connection is unavailable.
behavior.privacy: The preflight sends no licence page and stores no response. Provider error bodies and API keys are never printed or logged.
behavior.runtime_diagnostics: The OCR adapter logs only exception type, HTTP status, and provider request ID when available; the browser keeps receiving the existing sanitized error envelope.
behavior.operator_escape_hatch: -SkipOpenAIProbe is reserved for deliberate UI-only work without AI processing.
